object.title: Singleton-optimizer stability conjecture
object.statement: Let $OPT$ be the set of optimal vectors for the graph-density optimization problem under consideration, and let a problem be **stable** when every near-optimal graph is close to an optimal construction. **Singleton-optimizer stability conjecture.** If $OPT$ consists of a single point, then the problem is necessarily stable. The claim is posed as an open question in the paper; its general validity is not established there.
object.source_name: Hong Liu, Oleg Pikhurko, Maryam Sharifzadeh and Katherine Staden, “Stability from graph symmetrisation arguments with applications to inducibility”, arXiv:2012.10731 (2023).
object.references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.10731

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of December 2020).
